experiment: exp39 neighbourhood contradiction in three embedding spaces

one_sided_pairs: contradiction (AnySat local neighbours) vs contradiction (OlmoEarth neighbours)

spaces.pixel: per-window means of 12 log bands + NDWI mean, std, standardised
spaces.AnySat: torch.hub gastruc/anysat base, dense output pooled to 4-px windows (local half = P2 space, contextual half secondary), patch 40 m, bands ('B02', 'B03', 'B04', 'B05', 'B06', 'B07', 'B08', 'B8A', 'B11', 'B12'), standardised per testbed, one date, layout checked by a one-window roll

banks.scenes: windows of every rule scene on other rivers
banks.bolivia: Sen1Floods11 test split, exp18's 800-tile sample (seed 1), head never trained on it

prereg.P1: contradiction (OlmoEarth neighbours) beats confidence: capture at 10% on Bolivia, per-tile one-sided sign test + tile bootstrap; river vote on scenes alongside
prereg.P2: contradiction (AnySat local neighbours) beats confidence and beats contradiction (OlmoEarth neighbours), same tests
prereg.combination: U+ = midrank mean of confidence and the AnySat-space contradiction; void if AnySat is unavailable (OlmoEarth combination is then secondary)
prereg.falsification: no hand-label gain, or a gain the pixel-statistics ablation reproduces

part_a.bank: windows of the rule scenes on other rivers (all rule scenes, scored or not)

prereg.combination: U+ = mean of within-scene midrank percentiles of confidence and of the primary score
prereg.note: river-level one-sided exact sign tests are the inference; scene-level W/L/T are descriptive

anysat.output: dense, pooled to 4-px windows; local half = P2 space, contextual half = secondary
